title: project possible made with Fable 5
author: William Smith
verification: Fetched from X via twitter-cli from global-search; original author and post URL preserved.
note: Original post did not expose a complete repeatable prompt. Treat this as a real showcase post, not a verified tutorial.
originalText:
A long time coming. From a spec to ship, this project has grown right along with Claude codes capabilities. Its ability to reason, weigh options, present suggestions and research have made this project possible. 

I loved the ambient videos on YouTube. For a couple of years I always had these on every tv in my home. It helped me with focus/ADHD brain. About a year ago I decided to create my own station. 

I knew nothing about video models or looping videos and the software that came along with it. The amount of combinations of different LLMs, N8N other workflows, custome workflows, combo api, did not seem to ever work out. 

In the three days I had access to Fable 5, not only did it solve my issue something 4.6,4.7 and 4.8 could not solve! My autonomous workflow from idea to YouTube upload is live! 

I’m not gonna ask you to subscribe but just want to share my personal WIN! 

Still making little tweets but mostly prompt related. 

https://t.co/lHa6OFzVCz
summary: Describes an agentic workflow around Claude Fable 5, focused on motion-design rather than a simple chat response.
